lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately 12 primary spots visible in the mid-lateral field forming an irregular quadrilateral grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Interconnected labyrinthine bands of elevated pixel intensity that weave around and intersect with circular spots, creating non-linear anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge feature situated on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels dorsally to shadow-based low-luminance pixels ventrally.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced labyrinthine or vermiculated patterning of light-intensity lines surrounding the spots, deviating from standard vertical stripe morphology.
